latest.title: Z-Deck 0.2.55-cyberdeck

preUpdateBackup.reason: A/B app-only OTA does not write NVS, LittleFS, or SD; manual SD backup remains available as a separate queued action.

latest.notes: Nonblocking A/B app update for devices already using the dedicated MeshCore layout. Adds the integrated Z-Deck dashboard and Mesh Networks hub. Check and Apply queue work in the background and never overwrite MeshCore, NVS, LittleFS, SD files, channels, keys, or local preferences.
